highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: East Tennessee State University (ETSU) is a public university located in Johnson City, Tennessee. Founded in 1911, the university is dedicated to improving the quality of life for people in the region and beyond through its commitment to hands-on learning and real-world impact. ETSU offers over 180 highly respected academic programs, including undergraduate, master's, and doctoral degrees across diverse fields such as business, nursing, health professions, and the arts.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: <p>At ETSU, you will be part of a vibrant community of nearly 14,000 students from 80 countries. The university offers more than 300 student organizations, providing you with ample opportunities to find your place and connect with your peers. You can also engage in campus life through various events, Division 1 athletic teams, and support resources designed to help you succeed academically and personally.</p>

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: ETSU offers a variety of on-campus housing options designed to create a setting that enables learning. These residences are well-maintained, safe, and convenient, allowing you to maximize your involvement in campus activities. Additionally, the university provides information for students looking for off-campus rental properties. You can also choose from various meal plans, including options for residents and commuters, to enjoy dining at the Marketplace and other campus locations. If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
1. Library

The university library serves as a central hub for your academic journey, offering extensive resources and support to help you achieve your learning goals.

2. Sports

You will have access to a wide range of athletic facilities at ETSU. As a Division 1 school, the university supports an active sports culture with facilities that cater to various interests.

3. Laboratories

ETSU features specialized facilities across various colleges, such as the Lamb Hall and Nave Center, which house labs and clinical spaces for health-related disciplines like audiology, speech-language pathology, dental hygiene, and radiologic science.

4. Cafeteria

You can enjoy various dining options on campus, including the Marketplace residential dining hall, which offers all-you-care-to-eat meals, along with other convenient locations across the university grounds.

highlights.title: Campuses
highlights.value: The main campus of East Tennessee State University is located in Johnson City, Tennessee, set within an "outdoor-lover's paradise". The location provides easy access to beautiful mountain towns, lakes, rivers, and the Appalachian Trail, making it an ideal environment for those who enjoy outdoor exploration. The campus itself is well-connected and serves as the primary location for most academic programs and student facilities.
